title: Love it! (Dark Mode please)
body: The Routine feature is fantastic (it's customizable, has a wide selection of icons, and even better, you can pin it to your phone's toolbar!). It's consistently been one of my top favorite apps. Adding a "dark mode" would be a perfect finishing touch ( too bright at night). Thank you for developing this app, and I highly recommend it to new users!
author: CS-5276-4304
